threads.summary: Stale-directory hazard: legion.yaml is never removed by down.sh, so a directory whose pre-record rig was torn down long ago (yaml present, no record, no pids) still takes the legacy fallback and runs `docker rm -f legion-smoke-nats` on whoever owns that container now. Live at 11:20Z: /tmp/legion-smoke (the default SMOKE_DIR, what the README's `bash scripts/smoke/down.sh` acts on) has exactly that shape (project sjawhar/24, nats 14222, mtime 08:56Z) while `legion-smoke-nats` is Up since 11:16Z on 14262 (another tester's pre-PR rig). Reproduced with fake docker/tmux in a mktemp dir. Fix options: (1, recommended) no fallback removal — print the manual `docker rm -f legion-smoke-nats` instruction gated on `docker port` matching this rig's NATS_PORT; (2) fall back only when this run stopped a start-time-verified live daemon/listener from this directory's PID files. Either way: update the down.sh comment, README 104/110, down.test.sh's 'No record' case (assert refusal + empty docker log); consider removing legion.yaml and the record at the end of a successful teardown so a torn-down directory is inert for the tmux stop too. Spec Errors row 'down.sh finds no recorded name → removes the old fixed name and says so' must change — architect's call.

keyFindings.description: Legacy fixed-name fallback reachable from any stale pre-record directory (legion.yaml never revoked); removes another rig's live legion-smoke-nats. Exists on this machine now (/tmp/legion-smoke vs live legion-smoke-nats on 14262). Both thermo agents and I reproduced it with fakes; down.test.sh pins the behaviour as correct.
Write the record before legion.yaml so an interruption between the two writes leaves the shape down.sh ignores, not the legacy shape (moot if the fallback is removed).
started-a-rig gate has two predicates (-r legion.yaml vs rig_project success); resolve the project once in main and pass it.
-r sends a present-but-unreadable record down the legacy branch; fail closed (moot if fallback removed).
Comment 'Nothing that can refuse the rig runs after this point' overstated; wait_for_json/assert_webhook_round_trip/ensure_root_issue can fail.
Incident-narrating comments; keep the behavioural sentence.
main_with_real_port_check as subshell-bodied function; duplicated neither-file blocks; line 709 relies on a far-away export; no-rig case can assert an empty docker log.
'finding nothing' holds only for a directory up.sh refused; 'keep SMOKE_REPO exported' documents a gate (down.sh:113) whose value is never used.
SMOKE_PROJECT regex admits whitespace in the owner, which rig_project then rejects (fails closed; GitHub owners cannot contain whitespace). Accept as-is or tighten.
